newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end down on restriction.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end down on restriction.

text.p: Shanghai's B share index closed down in slow trade on Thursday on cautious sentiment triggered by the beginning of re-registration of B share account holders to force out illegal domestic investors, brokers said.
The index edged down 0.123 points or 0.20 percent to 61.890 points, on volume of 11.2 million shares worth $4.8 million against $5.4 million on Wednesday.

Brokers said major brokerages had begun to re-register B share accounts to push domestic investors out of the market. They said the re-registeration was ordered by the securities authorities and must be completed by March 15.
But some speculative institutional buying was seen supporting the market to prevent it from falling sharply, brokers said.

"Some negative factors, such as expectations of poor results of many firms and the ban on domestic investors, are worrying the market at the moment and investors are expected to liquidate their positions further in the short term," one broker said.
"The market will be short of funds again with overseas investors having little interest in it," he added.

Huangshan Tourism was the biggest loser on profit-taking, slipping $0.020 or 4.65 percent to $0.410 on volume of 41,000 shares.
Hua Xin Cement was the most active share on inter-institutional trading, ending unchanged at $0.230 on volume of 2.2 million shares.
Shanghai's A shares were weaker on concerns that the national bankers meeting in Beijing could decide to strengthen supervision over the market, brokers said.
The A index edged down 1.784 points or 0.19 percent to 955.175 points, on volume of 175.4 million shares worth 1.7 billion yuan.
But the SSE 30 blue-chip index inched up 6.317 points or 0.26 percent to 2434.646 points on institutional support in index-weighted stocks.
Cement maker Jianfeng was the biggest loser, falling 0.23 yuan or 3.23 percent to 6.90 yuan, on volume of 1.7 million shares.
Of 43 B shares, 42 traded with 15 down, eight flat and 19 up.
